description: The Supreme Court - The Court of Appeal (Appellate Procedure) Rules - 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made by the Supreme Court under Article 136 of the Constitution, amending the Court of Appeal (Appellate Procedure) Rules 1990. It establishes legal procedures and requirements for appellate court processes, including amendments to rules regarding petition captions, affidavit requirements, definitions of "Public Officer," and procedures for nominating legal representatives. This content falls squarely within the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves legal framework modifications and court procedural regulations.
